jei.siliconcraft.info.silicon_ore: Mined deep underground. Smelt or blast in a furnace to extract Silicon Powder, the cornerstone material for all silicon microelectronics.
jei.siliconcraft.info.silicon_powder: Refined from Silicon Ore. Essential semiconductor material used for forging processor chips, memory banks, and SoC substrate interconnects.
jei.siliconcraft.info.architecture_write: Created using the Architecture Writer. Defines the supported CPU instruction set (ISA). Placed inside a Chip Forge to print silicon dies.
Workstation for drafting CPU architecture writeups. Select from the 35 available ISA instructions to craft custom processor designs.
jei.siliconcraft.info.programmer: Hardware flasher used to burn compiled assembly programs onto ROM chips or Storage Drives, producing bootable firmware or software storage.
jei.siliconcraft.info.code_compiler: Compiles high-level N programming language files (.n) into native assembly programs validated against an Architecture Writeup.
jei.siliconcraft.info.project_compiler: Compiles multi-file N projects (.zip) with relative file imports into native assembly programs validated against an Architecture Writeup.
jei.siliconcraft.info.assembly_writer: Imports assembly files (.s / .asm) into the machine library after checking that all instructions are supported by an Architecture Writeup.
jei.siliconcraft.info.computer_case: Chassis for personal computers. Right-click the placed case with any assembled System-on-a-Chip (SoC) to complete computer assembly.
jei.siliconcraft.info.computer: A fully functional personal computer with CRT monitor, real-time terminal streaming, CPU registers, game-tick clock timing, and custom ISA execution.
jei.siliconcraft.info.speaker: A peripheral acoustic transducer. Place adjacent to a Personal Computer to broadcast its audio into the 3D world with spatial sound falloff.
config.jade.plugin_siliconcraft.computer: Displays CPU execution status, cycle counts, RAM/storage capacities, and SoC architecture information.
config.jade.plugin_siliconcraft.machine_: Displays energy (FE), fuel burn ticks, progress bars, and operational state for SiliconCraft machines.
config.jade.plugin_siliconcraft.speaker_: Displays acoustic link status and coordinate binding to adjacent Personal Computers.
